name: Account Contract 4
definition: Specifies target dates dates related to account opening and closing.

TargetClosingDate.name: Target Closing Date
TargetClosingDate.definition: Date on which the account and related services are expected to cease to be operational for the account owner.

UrgencyFlag.name: Urgency Flag
UrgencyFlag.definition: Indicator that the account opening/maintenance/closing process needs to be treated urgently, that is, sooner than the terms established by the service level agreed between the account holder customer and the account servicing institution.

RemovalIndicator.name: Removal Indicator
RemovalIndicator.definition: Indicates removal of the account. After removal, an account will not appear anymore in reports.
